policyWording: Context-menu write actions (add-phrase, block-author) issue no success or failure receipts by design. Duplicate / already-blocked repeats are idempotent no-ops (goal state already holds — silence is correct, not a defect); empty selections are vacuous input; caps (200 phrases / 100 authors / 120 chars), quota overflow, and transient write errors are rare and the options-page lists always show true state, which is the recourse. A worker-to-tab notice cannot reach off-LinkedIn tabs where both menus fire (no content script there), and a notification-based receipt would cost a new install permission for rare paths. Do not re-report this silence as a fresh finding without new evidence.
